description:
Fast, offline-first terminal logger for amateur radio operators.

CQOps is a small, fast, offline-first amateur radio logger for the terminal. It supports keyboard and WSJT-X logging, multiple operators and logbooks, SOTA/POTA/WWFF references, contest workflows, rig control, GPS, APRS, Wavelog synchronization, and a read-only live dashboard. It is designed for portable operations, club stations, SSH sessions, and low-power computers.
DXC path line smart filtering (continent, mode, time) with cascading fallback. DXCC badge case-insensitive matching fix. Hamlib mode recognition (PKTUSB, PKTLSB, CWR, RTTYR). Band plan SAT false-positive fix. Cross-platform branding consistency — unified descriptions, desktop entries, AUR metadata, Windows installer, and CI validation. New branding-check CI workflow (6 jobs).
